snippet.title: Ben 10: Omnitrix Power - Gameplay Walkthrough (iOS, Android)
snippet.description:
Psyphon has unleashed his alien hoard on Undertown in an attempt to destroy it once and for all. To save the city, Ben must avoid a slew of aliens and obstacles while collecting enough strength to fight Psyphon’s henchmen in alien combat. Use the Omnitrix to transform into your favorite aliens and increase their power with Omniboxes. 

Download link - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.globalfun.vilgax.google
